faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What data do my clients need to share?
faq.a1: Your clients download the free Ziko app and create an account. By accepting your invitation, you get read-only access to their data: sessions, measurements, sleep, nutrition, RPE, habits, and cardio. No manual sharing required — everything syncs automatically.
faq.a2: Yes. Ziko is 100% free during the private beta. No credit card required. We'll notify you before any pricing changes.
faq.q3: What platforms does the athlete app run on?
faq.a3: The Ziko athlete app is available on iOS (iPhone) and Android. The coach CRM is a web app that works in any modern browser.
faq.q4: How many clients can I manage?
faq.a4: Unlimited during the private beta. We'll evaluate limits based on coach feedback before the public launch.
faq.q5: Can my clients see my coach data?
faq.a5: No. Access is one-directional: you see your linked clients' data, but your clients have no access to your coach space. The link is revocable at any time by the client.
faq.q6: How do I link a client to my coach space?
faq.a6: From your dashboard, generate a 6-character invitation code. Your client enters it in the Ziko app > "My coach". The link is instant.
